title: The Paper Letter
author: Jonah Yarrow
blurb: Wendell Yarrow, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
